name: MiniMax H3 Images
description: Stills from a video model, one latent slice at a time

paragraphs: MiniMax-H3 has no image mode. The method here is the one described by iamkaikai/MiniMax-H3-Single-Frame-VAE-500K: run H3's ordinary t2va generation, then decode one temporal latent slice of the result as a still, using that repo's decoder-only retrain of H3's video autoencoder.

The decode is that card's reference recipe, unmodified. The one deliberate divergence is generation length: the card generates a full-length clip, this defaults to the shortest H3 will produce, and the length is a user control so the divergence is exposed rather than hidden.

One latent frame decodes to 4 pixel frames, of which only the last is sharp — hence [-1]. Across slices, index 0 is clean at every length tested (5 / 22 / 39 / 56 / 124); later slices carry a regular mesh that grows with clip length, because a longer shot makes the transformer write motion into each slice and a still-image decoder renders that motion as a grid. Reconstruction agrees: on a static image encoded to vlat = 2, slice 0 scores 26.16 dB and slice 1 scores 16.20 dB.
